title: FUKUSHIMA 50
en: While everyone was running, a few went back in.
Radiation was rising. Most of the workers were pulled out.
But some stayed behind. The world called them the Fukushima 50.
They went into dark buildings and, by torchlight, opened valves by hand.
Plant manager Masao Yoshida kept pumping sea water into the reactors.
On 17 March, army helicopters began dropping water from above.
Fire engines sprayed jets of water day and night.
Their courage held back a far bigger disaster.
